description: List recent delivery attempts for a webhook endpoint. Each delivery includes id, event_type, status (pending, delivered, failed), HTTP response code, attempt count, and timestamps. Filter by status or event_type. Keyset cursor pagination via the cursor field. Use this to debug failing webhook endpoints.

status.description: Filter by status: pending, delivered, failed

name: social_api_list_webhook_deliveries
title: List Webhook Deliveries
